ns2:course.label: Intro Hum Comm Sys & Disorders
ns2:course.description: Examines broad perspectives of theories and information regarding normal and abnormal communication: how speech and language develop, how people hear, how they produce speech and what can go wrong; addresses the impact of speech and hearing science on society, culture, and modern technologies.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Beh Sci course.
